ranking_criterion: highest benchmark-contract compatibility at minimum algorithmic rewriting; NOT published performance
primary_rationale: Highest task compatibility (single UAV tracking a moving target through clutter with an occlusion term already in its objective), no training required because it is a classical planner, released arena already close to MOTAR's, and an obstacle-aware target in its released configuration. It also addresses whether the frozen learned policy and a classical visibility-aware planner exhibit different success, collision and failure profiles under partially matched scenarios, which no existing MOTAR result covers.

meaningful: classical prediction and reacquisition under clutter

NavRL.blocking_reason: does not track a target; a moving goal needs retraining or runs out of distribution

OPEN.sensor_compat: none (privileged relative state + LOS bit, no camera)
OPEN.blocking_reason: multi-agent coordination and privileged state are both load-bearing; removing them removes the method

Fast-Tracker.blocking_reason: simulation benchmark feeds the planner a ground-truth future trajectory; marker-based target detection

Elastic Tracker.blocking_reason: cooperative broadcast target must be replaced by a replayed trajectory; action space and vehicle model differ

YOPO.blocking_reason: different simulator stack, primitive-library action space, and no target tracking

YOPOv2-Tracker.blocking_reason: repository is a placeholder; code unreleased, so no port is possible
YOPOv2-Tracker.role: closest task semantics of any surveyed work

b0_upstream_reproduction.cause: ROS 1 is not installed and cannot be installed without root; disk at 97%
b0_upstream_reproduction.integration_mode_reason: Elastic Tracker is GPL-3.0 and MOTAR is BSD-3-Clause; vendoring would impose GPL-3 on the combined work
b0_upstream_reproduction.public_simulation_target_input: ground-truth target odometry (/target/odom) fed directly to the EKF; check_fov defaults to false and simulation1.launch does not enable it
